Why TIMB Press Entry Line?
  • Precision strip feeding — consistent pitch accuracy critical to fine blanking tolerances
  • Heavy coil capacity — handles coils up to 3000 Kg and Ø1800mm OD for extended, uninterrupted runs
  • Wide material range — 2–10.5mm thickness and 55–360mm width covers diverse chain & component profiles
  • Integrated hydraulic & pneumatic control — 100 Bar hydraulic clamping with 5 Bar pneumatic assist for stable, repeatable feeding
  • High-speed capability up to 16 m/min, matched to modern high-tonnage press cycle rates
  • Robust industrial-duty construction engineered for continuous, high-volume production
  • Fast coil changeover minimizes press downtime and maximizes line utilisation
  • Custom-engineered to match specific press bed height, tonnage & tooling requirements
Complete Coil-to-Press Feed Line
Decoiler, Straightener & Servo Feed
  • Motorized decoiler with mandrel expansion holds coils up to Ø1800mm OD / 3000Kg, paying off strip under controlled tension
  • Precision roller straightener removes coil-set, camber & cross-bow for dead-flat strip entering the press
  • Hydraulic clamping (100 Bar) with pneumatic assist (5 Bar) holds strip position with zero slip during high-speed feed cycles
  • Fully guarded, PLC-integrated line synchronizes feed pitch with press stroke for consistent, high-tolerance fine blanking
